_meta.title: CONTEXT.md byte ceiling (#1985)
_meta.description: Anti-regrowth ratchet on CONTEXT.md as a whole file. It is pull-only, but a pull-only file still gets read whole when nothing narrows the read: a /grill run read it together with a 202 KB research doc and compacted 3 times before Phase 1 (retro 2026-10-07). tests/ci/test_context_md_ceiling_guard.py fails when the file exceeds the ceiling below.
_meta.mechanism: Same mechanism as the push-surface ratchet (#1273, tests/ci/fixtures/push_surface_ceilings.json + a tests/ci guard test, later retired by #1800): the guard reads the ceiling only from this file, so raising it is impossible without editing it in the same PR. Regrowth is a reviewable act.
_meta.unit: UTF-8 bytes of Path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), which normalizes CRLF to LF. NOT `wc -c`: a Windows checkout with autocrlf counts the CRLF bytes and reads about 250 bytes higher than the CI runner.
_meta.margin: Measured 68,858 bytes when set (2026-10-07, after adding the section index and research pointer); ceiling 70,000 = +1,142 bytes (about 1.7%). Small on purpose: room for a few glossary entries, not for a new section.
_meta.raising: Prefer trimming (How to grow this file, rule 4) or moving a section to docs/reference/*.md. If the content must stay, raise the ceiling here in the same PR and say why in the PR body.
